description: Implementation of SerialPort class with platform-specific code for serial communication, including monitoring, configuration, opening, closing, reading, and writing serial ports on POSIX and Windows systems.

classes.name: SerialMonitor
classes.description: Platform-specific class for monitoring serial port events, with a nested MonitorWorker thread class, managing monitored serial ports and event handling.

methods.name: LastError
methods.description: Retrieves the last system error message on Windows.

methods.name: ~SerialMonitor
methods.description: Destructor for SerialMonitor, cleans up resources.

methods.name: Monitor
methods.description: Adds a SerialPort instance to be monitored for events.

methods.name: Break
methods.description: Signals the monitor thread to wake up.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Main loop of the monitor thread, waiting for serial port events.

methods.name: SerialPort
methods.description: Class for serial port communication, including configuration, open/close, read/write, and platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a numeric speed to a BaudRate enum.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the serial port with specified settings.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for the serial port to close or timeout.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Signals the serial port to perform an action, e.g., write event.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Returns the current event mask for polling.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Returns the platform-specific handle or descriptor.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the serial port.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the serial port.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Applies serial port settings such as baud rate, parity, flow control.
